name: Seven Nexus
source:
Seven Nexus follows the story of Grey, a man who dies a sudden death and learns he’s an anomaly - a Nexus Being. No one knows how he lived or died, and as such, he can’t be judged by Purgatory. He doesn’t belong in either Heaven or Hell.

To decide his fate, Grey must travel back to the human realm and complete Seven Trials, accompanied by two unlikely Guardians: an angel and a devil. Bound by the Supreme Being, they can guide, support, and tempt Grey but never interfere. Only Grey’s choices, virtuous or sinful, can shape the path ahead.

Walk beside Grey as he makes difficult decisions that affect more than just his own fate. Grow closer to his Guardians and uncover their stories and secrets. Forge bonds that may lead him to his true calling, and perhaps, to something even more meaningful… love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603420/Seven_Nexus/]Steam[/url]]
